title: China set to open Pinglu Canal – its new shortcut to South-East Asia
content:
China is plotting a shortcut for shipping from its south-west region to South-east Asia with the opening of the Pinglu Canal on 15 September.
The $10.8bn waterway connects Nanning, in the Guangxi Zhuang autonomous region, to Beibu Gulf, between China and Vietnam.
South-east Asia is now China’s largest trading partner, with $766bn of trade in the first seven months of 2026.

title: BBC: At least five dead after Amazon cargo plane speeds off runway at Miami airport
content:
BBC reports:
Just before 14:00 on Sunday, a Boeing 767-300 cargo plane was landing at Miami International Airport when it overran the runway.
The Amazon Prime Air flight struck “multiple vehicles” on the road behind the airport, killing at least five people and injuring five more. Officials have said three of those people are in a critical condition.
The crash prompted a significant emergency response, with various crews onsite to manage the subsequent aircraft .
